text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, furosemide injection remains in shortage. FDA first posted the shortage on 2020-04-07 and it is still Current. Corvale East holds 82 vials (8.5 days) of 10 mg/mL 2 mL injection (Accord NDC 16729-500-08, manufactured by Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited, FEI 3004011473). Corvale Lakeside holds 67 vials (28 days) of the same strength and volume. Corvale General holds multiple lots totaling 490 vials (18–19 days) of 10 mg/mL injection (Hospira NDC 0409-6102-02, labeled with Hospira, Inc. FEI 1021343 and Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited FEI 3008316085). Tablet inventory at all sites exceeds 24 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1106244 at Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) ended 2019-09-06, classified OAI. FDA inspection 1191818 at Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004011473) ended 2022-12-02, classified OAI; classification letter dated 2023-04-05. Import alert 66-40 for Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited was published 2023-06-01 and again 2023-11-14. The shortage posting predates the Intas OAI and import alert.

Our position: The injection shortage is long-standing. Corvale East is below target days on hand. Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General have sufficient supply to support a transfer without dropping below two weeks. Alternative manufacturers (Amneal, Camber, Civica) are not on FDA’s shortage list but their labels do not identify plants we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 33 vials of furosemide 10 mg/mL 2 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. If additional supply is needed, transfer 53 vials of furosemide 10 mg/mL 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., or Civica, Inc. for future orders — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
